movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Dancers hold hands in open or closed circles, or cross arms; men take the front of the line in Thrace.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Open circles, lines, couples, or solo improvisations by the leader.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Aegean and Cretan dances are light and jumpy; Epirus and Peloponnese use heavy, grounded steps.
movement_profile.partnering: Couples in Aegean dances, otherwise community line or circle formation.
movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies from slow and heavy in Epirus to fast, light, and jumpy in Crete and the Aegean.

music_profile.sound_description: Accompanied by traditional instruments like the Pontian lyra or bouzouki, featuring regional folk melodies ranging from the heavy, slow tones of Epirus to the fast, upbeat rhythms of Thrace.
music_profile.vocal_style: Traditional singing by participants and musicians

teaching.formation: Open or closed circles, lines, or couples
teaching.level_notes: Strict order in arrangement by age; Epirus requires great balance; Aegean dances are fast and jumpy.
